welcome_message.title: Welcome to the official website of the Ministry of Special Duties, Imo State.
welcome_message.content: We are committed to coordinating special assignments and handling strategic government interventions that cut across various sectors in the state. Whether responding to emergencies, overseeing special projects, or facilitating high-impact initiatives, our role is central to the smooth operation of government and the achievement of state-wide development goals. Our ministry acts as a bridge between the Governor's special directives and the implementing agencies, ensuring that every assignment is executed with precision, urgency, and public impact.

about_us.overview: The Ministry of Special Duties is a dynamic arm of the Imo State Government, created to handle assignments that fall outside the direct scope of conventional ministries. It oversees strategic interventions, inter-governmental collaborations, disaster response, and implementation of high-level projects as directed by the Executive Governor.

sections.who_we_are: The Ministry of Special Duties, Imo State plays a strategic role in executing priority mandates of the state government. We handle high-impact assignments, emergency responses, inter-agency coordination, and special interventions that demand urgent and cross-functional delivery.
sections.vision: To be a dynamic and responsive arm of government, delivering timely special assignments and interventions that strengthen governance, promote resilience, and enhance the wellbeing of all citizens across Imo State.
sections.mission: To coordinate and implement the Governor's special mandates through strategic planning, emergency response, inter-agency collaboration, and efficient execution of high-impact projects ensuring fast, transparent, and citizen-focused service delivery throughout Imo State.

core_values.integrity: We maintain accountability and transparency in all our operations.
core_values.responsiveness: We act swiftly to emergencies and special assignments.
core_values.collaboration: We work closely with ministries, agencies, and communities to drive results.
core_values.service: We put the welfare of the people at the center of every mandate.
core_values.excellence: We uphold professionalism and high standards in project delivery.

departments.name: Emergency Management and Disaster Response Department
departments.description: Responsible for coordinating state-level responses to emergencies, natural disasters, and crises (often works closely with SEMA/NEMA).

departments.name: Special Projects & Interventions Department
departments.description: Oversees the execution and supervision of high-impact, governor-mandated projects that fall outside routine ministerial duties.

departments.name: Inter-Ministerial Coordination Department
departments.description: Ensures synergy between various ministries and agencies during the implementation of cross-sectoral initiatives.

departments.name: Protocol and Events Management Department
departments.description: Handles state ceremonies, official events, and the Governor's special engagements requiring logistical coordination.

departments.name: Strategic Planning & Monitoring Department
departments.description: Focuses on policy formulation, project evaluation, and performance tracking of special interventions.

departments.name: Administration and Finance Department
departments.description: Manages internal human resources, budgeting, and procurement for the ministry.

commissioner.name: Dr. (Sir) Chika Abazu
commissioner.title: Commissioner, Ministry of Special Duties
commissioner.background: A highly accomplished Public Health Physician with over 22 years of distinguished service in the Federal Civil Service, rising to the rank of Director. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated integrity, dedication, and a passion for excellence in service delivery for the benefit of humanity.
commissioner.education: He holds degrees from Abia State University, Nigeria Defence Academy Kaduna, West Virginia University, USA, and Emory University, USA.
commissioner.personal: He is happily married and blessed with children.
commissioner.leadership_qualities: A God-fearing, honest, hardworking, and focused leader who does not make empty promises.
